title: Stablecoin Classification - DemoCo Holdings at 2026-06-30
conclusionSummary: DUSD held directly with issuer redemption rights at par is a financial asset — a receivable-like claim on the issuer — in both wallets, not cash or a cash equivalent (it has no maturity; AICPA Practice Aid view); XEUR, an algorithmic token with no redemption right, is an ASC 350-60 crypto asset at fair value.
